text:
samir: Quick thought — for free/low-tier plans, prefer frugal model variants (8-bit / quantized) and enforce a per-request token ceiling. High-level: policy layer decides routing by customer_tier + region + route_pref. Should be opt-in via console or opt-out for enterprise.
jen: +1. Telemetry requirements: effective cost-per-token, fallback count, and quality-regression signals tied to prompt sets. Need labels by tier and region.
li: Implementation Q: how do callers opt out/override? header? api param? per-api-key metadata?
omar: We already have a small routing metadata blob used by autoscaler. Could extend with "cost_preference": "frugal" or numeric "token_budget": 512. That keeps changes client-facing minimal.
carla: Console UX: add a per-project toggle "Prefer frugal variants" with a slider for max tokens per request and a clear note about potential quality/latency tradeoffs. Include a one-click rollback and audit trail.
samir: Rolling strategy: Shadow route 10% of requests -> frugal for 2 weeks, collect quality deltas via eval harness. If MTurk-like score drop > threshold -> rollback. Docs + changelog before canary.
jen: Telemetry: add metric namespace "fallback_rate.frugal" tagged by tier/region/model, and dashboards showing pct fallback, avg latency delta, and estimated $ saved. Alert on sharp rises in fallback rate or quality regressions.
li: Edge cases: accounts with mixed tiers or premium routes on same org. Need per-route annotation and per-api-key override precedence rules.
omar: Proposal for request payload snippet:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-nano-1",
  "routing": {"preference":"frugal","token_budget":512}
}
```
This can be optional; server-side policies still apply if absent.
carla: Billing note: metering must reflect the actual model executed. If a premium customer is routed to frugal variant by policy, do not silently change billing. Only apply cost-savings billing if customer explicitly opts in or contract allows it.
samir: Action items:
- @omar: design API/headers and fallback priority matrix (include region penalties)
- @jen: telemetry metrics + dashboard mocks
- @li: console toggle + rollout UX and audit trail
- @carla: billing/product change doc
- I'll own rollout plan + shadow run orchestration
Can folks sync tomorrow 10:00am PST?
jen: SGTM. I'll mock prometheus/grafana panels and push a PR with metric names.
pr-bot: Deploy: feature-flag 'frugal-routing' toggled ON in staging.
li: Also: frugal variants may not exist in all regions. Add region penalty matrix so routing scores prefer local cheap variant then fall back to nearest non-frugal or hosted fallback.
omar: Acknowledged — will encode region penalties in routing table and ensure autoscaler respects affinity.
samir: :thumbsup:
